description: Block-centric plate tank - Energy comes back from being hit (Recuperation), mitigation stacks off blocks rather than avoidance, and Raise Shield resets off your own strikes.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_guardian__vanguard.txt. CoA calls this the Protection Warrior analog and 'the safest tank in COA'. Block, not avoidance, is the chassis - its stat priority is Defense > Stamina > Expertise > Block Rating/Value > Strength > Dodge/Parry, which is why the tree spends far more on block chance, block value and critical block than on dodge or parry.

nodes.name: Seasoned Fighter
nodes.description: Reduces the Energy cost of your abilities by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Seasoned Fighter cuts ability costs'.

nodes.name: Fine Plating
nodes.description: Increases your Armor by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Fine Plating stacks Physical damage reduction with every block'. The stacking half is not modellable in a turn engine, so it lands as flat Armor.

nodes.name: Valiant Defender
nodes.description: Increases your maximum Energy by 6 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Valiant Defender raises your max Energy'.

nodes.name: Iron Guardian
nodes.description: Increases your total health by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Iron Guardian scales max HP'. NOTE max_health_pct is a FRACTION - health * (1.0 + value) - not percent points like armor_pct. Shipped at 2.0 (+200% a rank), which gave this spec 26,700 health and 99,156 effective HP against the next tank's 2,987. tools/validate_class.py now fails a value an order of magnitude off convention.

nodes.name: Shield Training
nodes.description: Increases your chance to block by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA lists Shield Training among the block-scaling mitigation talents.

nodes.name: Recuperation
nodes.description: Increases the Armor of your shield by 8% per rank, and hardens you against the blows it catches.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Recuperation refunds Energy whenever you take or block a physical hit'. The Energy refund has no engine hook, so the node carries shield Armor instead - named and placed for the real talent.

nodes.name: Defender's Resolve
nodes.description: Reduces all damage you take by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: The flat-mitigation node every tank tree needs; CoA calls Guardian 'the best damage mitigation in the game', so it gets a real one.

nodes.name: Honorable Demeanor
nodes.description: Increases your Stamina by 2% and Strength by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Honorable Demeanor turns blocks into stacking Strength and Stamina'.

nodes.name: Iron Barrier
nodes.description: Your blocks absorb an additional 8% of the damage dealt to you, per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Iron Barrier gives your blocks a chance to critically block for double'. block_bonus_reduction is the engine's existing critical-block hook, read in Character.take_damage.

nodes.name: Bulwark
nodes.description: Grants 1 hit rating and 4 Stamina per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Bulwark converts Stamina into hit rating'. A real conversion is impossible here - hit_rating is a local feeding base_miss_chance_*, not a Character attribute, so it cannot be a <target>_from_<source>_pct target without restructuring that loop. Flat hit + Stamina instead.

nodes.name: Resilient
nodes.description: Increases your total health by 2% and reduces the chance you are critically hit by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Resilient bumps max HP on blocks under Raise Shield'. Doubles as the tree's crit-immunity path, which its stat priority leads with ('Defense (to crit-immunity)').

nodes.name: King's Guard
nodes.description: Your Ram and Pulverize have a 15% chance per rank to reset Raise Shield.
nodes._source: CoA: 'King's Guard (Pulverize and Ram have a chance to reset Raise Shield's cooldown)'. A cooldown reset has no proc shape, so it grants a block window instead - the same thing the reset would have bought.

nodes.name: Improved Brace
nodes.description: Brace lasts 1 turn longer per rank.
nodes._source: ability_<id>_<stat> keys are built by interpolation in abilities.py - a literal grep calls them dead, which is why 48 of them were once reported so.

nodes.name: Vanguard's Might
nodes.description: Heavy Blow leaves your allies taking 4% less damage per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Heavy Blow (line hit, high threat, grants Vanguard's Might's party damage-reduction aura)'.

nodes.name: Paragon
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Heavy Blow by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Paragon banks them for a payoff', an empowered Heavy Blow.

nodes.name: Refuse To Die
nodes.description: While below 35% health, you take 8% less damage per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Refuse To Die (Advance resets it outright)'. The name is a last-stand name, so it carries the engine's low-health mitigation pair.

nodes.name: One Man Army
nodes.description: Increases the damage Pulverize deals to additional targets by 15% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Pulverize (cleaves extra targets via One Man Army)'.

nodes.name: Retaliation
nodes.description: Blows you block are answered in kind.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Retaliation is Revenge-flavored auto-retaliation where blocks strike back', 'largely passive'.

nodes.name: Footman's Call
nodes.description: Increases your threat generation by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: Guardian's threat talent, at Warrior Defiance's 8%/rank - the two Protection analogs should hold threat equally. Note the key: threat_generation_pct as a TALENT effect is a fraction and only started working in 992ed62.

nodes.name: Shield Mastery
nodes.description: Increases the damage absorbed by your blocks by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: Block VALUE, the other half of the two-stat block system (chance rolls, value absorbs).

nodes.name: Unyielding
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of stuns used against you by 15% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Unlike stock Prot Warrior, Vanguard has no AoE stun' - it resists them instead.

nodes.name: Tower of Strength
nodes.description: Increases your Armor by 5% and your block chance by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: The pre-capstone mitigation stack.

nodes.name: Last Stand of the Line
nodes.description: While you hold the line, nothing behind you falls. You take 15% less damage and your allies 10% less.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA: Guardian has 'the best damage mitigation in the game' and Vanguard is 'the safest tank in COA: many shields + mitigation CDs ... Nearly unkillable, just slower kills'.
